model_ids.description:
required without a minimum length: the field must be PRESENT, and an
empty array is the meaningful "empty the set" request.

unrestricted.description:
Unrestricted sets the set to every model the gateway serves, including
models configured later. Mutually exclusive with a non-empty model_ids:
sending both is a 400 rather than a guess, because "unrestricted, and also
these three" has two defensible readings and the wider one is a silent
privilege grant.

It is a FLAG, not a reserved model id. The storage encoding is the
directory's own and never appears on the wire in either direction — a
magic value in an id field is the wildcard-injection shape that turns an
identifier parameter into an authorization widening.

Any set may be set unrestricted, not only the baseline, and the write is
reversible in both directions.
